mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_wishlists (user_id, uniform_id, added_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{uniformId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM s_wishlists WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND uniform_id = #{uniformId}
mapper.select: SELECT w.wishlist_id, w.user_id, w.uniform_id, w.added_time, u.name as uniform_name_alias, u.price as uniform_price_alias, u.image as uniform_image_alias, s.school_name as school_name_alias, g.grade_name as grade_name_alias FROM s_wishlists w JOIN s_uniform u ON w.uniform_id = u.id LEFT JOIN s_schools s ON u.school_id = s.school_id LEFT JOIN s_grades g ON u.grade_id = g.grade_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.added_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_wishlists WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND uniform_id = #{uniformId}
